newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares ease after German EMU talks.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares ease after German EMU talks.

text.p: Austria's blue-chip ATX index dropped on Friday amid profit-taking and uncertainty over a possible delay of EMU, but traders predicted the market would pick up again next week.
The market fell in line with the DAX on speculation that Germany would announce a delay for European economic and monetary union, but the Bundesbank and German finance ministry denied the rumours.
The ATX index of 21 blue chips was seen heading to 1,240, traders said.
The ATX tumbled 11.82 points or 0.96 percent to 1,223.97. Among its constituents four shares rose, 15 fell and two remained unchanged.
Austrian microchip maker AMS led the decliners, easing 3.71 percent to 1,117 schillings.
The session's top gainer was beverage group BBAG, climbing 0.83 percent to 730 schillings.
The March ATX future dropped 14.5 points at 1,226.5.
